vape_chassis_recycled_matte_asa.structural_purpose: Tactile, sleek exterior electronic enclosure. Fixed outer wall speeds of 120mm/s ensure clean layer-to-layer weld line integration. This delivers a premium consumer finish right off the print bed, completely eliminating labor-intensive chemical smoothing steps.

retention_ring_flexible_high_rebound_tpu.structural_purpose: Glue-free mechanical snap retention gasket. Printed out of high-rebound TPU with a slow volumetric feed rate to allow the internal cell hinges to compress and snap lock repeatedly without fracturing or loss of tension.
